Initial release of url-to-markdown-api.

- Read any web page by URL and extract content as Markdown, plain text, or raw HTML.
- Offers three fetch modes: normal (datacenter), advanced (renders JavaScript), and ultra (heavy anti-bot).
- Tiered credit pricing: normal/advanced cost 1 credit, ultra costs 2 credits, only billed for successful extraction.
- Accepts only http(s) URLs; local and private addresses are blocked.
- Flexible usage: useful for summarizing, quoting, or processing web content for LLMs or agents.
- Includes detailed setup, usage examples, parameters, and robust failure handling.
